SELECT zip_code, AVG(mean_sea_level_pressure_inches) as avg_pressure
FROM weather
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY avg_pressure ASC
LIMIT 1;

Natural Language Query: Give me ids for all the trip that took place in a zip code area with average mean temperature above 60.
Generated SQL Query:
SELECT trip.id
FROM trip
JOIN weather ON trip.zip_code = weather.zip_code
GROUP BY trip.id
HAVING AVG(weather.mean_temperature_f) > 60;

Natural Language Query: For each zip code, find the ids of all trips that have a higher average mean temperature above 60?
Generated SQL Query:
SELECT trip.id, weather.zip_code
FROM trip
JOIN weather ON trip.start_date = weather.date
GROUP BY weather.zip_code
HAVING AVG(weather.mean_temperature_f) > 60;
